extension_description.message: Sends open pages and formatted text with images to an e-reader through the installed TabTome app.

paste_placeholder.message: Paste text or an image with Ctrl+V

text_hint.message: Paragraphs, headings, lists, links, tables, and images are preserved. Page colors, fonts, and styles are removed. An unfinished draft stays in browser memory until the browser closes.
